prompts.logo: Create a premium transparent-background horizontal logo asset for D2PLUS, a dark gothic Diablo II fan expansion website inspired by old early-2000s Battle.net portals. Exact only text: D2PLUS. Make the lettering a richly illustrated 3D sculptural emblem: deeply chiselled weathered pale stone letter faces, dark gunmetal edges, very restrained aged gold bevels, sharp gothic serif silhouettes. The 2 is legible as the numeral 2. Integrate a modest dark gothic architectural arch and symmetric carved angel/demon motifs behind and beside the word, weathered burgundy roses and black thorn vines along a lower iron flourish. Strong readable wordmark at 500px width, wide aspect 3:1. Authentic grim gothic game interface craftsmanship, realistic carved materials, crisp lighting, subtle crimson glow through fissures, no flat plain gold typography, no bright neon, no extra words, no tagline, no version, no enclosing rectangle. Everything outside the emblem fully transparent. Center complete emblem with generous transparent margin, no clipping.
prompts.stone: Create a seamless tileable square material texture for an old-school gothic fantasy videogame website UI inspired by classic Battle.net. Front-on orthographic view of very dark charcoal grey basalt masonry: tightly fitted broad old stone slabs with low subtle variations, worn chiselled edges, fine pitting and mineral grain, faint shallow seams, subtle age and grime. Near-black cool slate palette, realistic tactile medieval stone, no vegetation, no roses, no symbols, no letters, no gold, no border, no objects, no scenery, no strong directional shadows, no perspective. Quiet even low-contrast texture behind readable cream text, authentic stone not black painted wood. All four edges seamlessly tile.
